notes.title: Trading Cards, Badges, and Profile Backgrounds
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that we are adding the following community items for Gray Destiny.

[h2]Trading Cards, Badges, and Profile Backgrounds[/h2]
Dive deeper into the Gray Destiny universe with our exciting collection of trading cards, badges, and profile backgrounds! Show off your accomplishments and milestones as you progress through the game. Trade with fellow players to complete your collection or sell them on the marketplace, and customize your gaming profile with stunning artworks that capture the essence of Gray Destiny.

[h2]Launch Discount - 15% Off for One Week[/h2]
To celebrate the "Gray Destiny" launch, we're offering an exclusive [b]15% discount for the first week[/b] after release! Don't miss this opportunity to embark on your epic adventure at a reduced price. Whether you're a seasoned adventurer or new to indie games, now is the perfect time to grab your copy and unveil the secrets that await.

[h2]Get ready[/h2]
Mark your calendars or wishlist the game, for the release on [b]14th August 2023[/b] and follow the game on Steam for the latest updates, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes content leading up to the launch.
